name: Kunoichi Sakuya "Shinobishi Omoi wa Chijoku ni Nurete..."
original_name: くのいち・咲夜「忍びし想いは恥辱に濡れて……」
source:
Here comes a new item from "Lune". This item features Japanese traditional character, "Kunoichi", female Ninja. Also, this item includes training part, scout part and hard training part full of training situations. This is one of the best "Kunoichi" training games ever.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090103025902/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1003227]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
‘Lune’推出的新作，以日本传统角色‘女忍者’为主题。游戏包含调教部分、侦察部分和充满各种调教情境的严酷训练部分，堪称最出色的女忍者调教游戏之一。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090103025902/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1003227]Eroge Shop[/url]]
